title: Bessent Orders Global Bank to Cancel China As US Just Banned DeepSeek
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: China's cheaper capital (1.8% vs 5.2%) and stronger currency give it an edge; US targets China's developing-nation status.
Chinese open-source models are far cheaper; US bans like DeepSeek ring-fence US AI while signs of an AI bubble popping grow.
Iran war keeps rates and inflation high and squeezes consumers.

calls.reason: The dollar is slowly dropping while the yuan gains; US borrowing costs high.
calls.quote: the dollar is slowly dropping against other currencies

notes: Mostly geopolitics; dollar view is a passing structural claim (low conviction).
